interpretation: Retrospective fixed-reference assessment of existing source-defined goals, not a prospective goal or proof of historical executor continuity. Contract authored after the frozen cutoff. Introduction dates require actual parent/tree proof; first observed outputs are not adoption.

period.deliveryTime: immutable implementation merge time, never issue creation, closure, report publication or job success
period.deduplication: one accepted native opportunity per implementation transition and module/site/version tuple; cross-workflow overlap is shared contribution, not additive repository value

contracts.goal: Remediate grouped Dependabot PRs for generated workflow manifests by updating the actual workflow sources and regenerating their manifests in one bounded replacement change.
contracts.eligible: An identified generated-manifest dependency bump whose underlying source still uses the superseded version before the accepted replacement merge.
contracts.nativePartial: Count distinct dependency/version targets actually advanced in immutable editable workflow sources and reflected in the corresponding generated manifests after the same implementation merge. An equal, removed, unrelated or downgraded pin is not a delivered target.
contracts.strictAcceptance: Native partial condition plus authoritative selected Dependabot batch, source-to-generated mapping and successful required regeneration/build at the accepted revision; selected original PRs resolved by the replacement and no unrelated/risky changes.
contracts.excluded: Direct edits only to generated manifests; PR counts; reports; claimed status improved; dependency updates outside the selected generated-manifest family.

contracts.goal: Identify direct Go dependency and Playwright CLI update opportunities, assess compatibility conservatively, group genuinely safe single-step patches, separate uncertain/minor updates and skip major or breaking updates.
contracts.eligible: A concrete workflow-recommended update of a direct root go.mod dependency or the source-defined Playwright CLI constant, with old and proposed versions independently tied to repository state.
contracts.nativePartial: Count distinct recommended dependency/version targets delivered by a later immutable implementation merge: direct dependency or Playwright CLI source pin changes from the recommended old version to the recommended newer version. This is implemented advice, not proof of correct compatibility categorization or causation.
contracts.strictAcceptance: Independent source-era release/changelog and opportunity population prove correct A/B/C classification, required grouping/individualization/skips and issue cleanup; native delivered target plus independent required compatibility tests at the accepted implementation revision.
contracts.excluded: Indirect-only updates; major or explicitly breaking recommendations under the frozen reference policy; issue closure as delivery; available-version counts; unverified changelog claims.
safeguards: no direct update by advisory workflow

contracts.goal: Review direct Go module usage and identify actionable improvements to API usage, error handling, configuration, performance or use of available module features.
contracts.eligible: A concrete module-usage recommendation from an identified review, linked to an independently observable repository condition and later implementation.
contracts.nativePartial: Count distinct module-usage sites changed from the recommendation's explicit undesirable condition to its recommended structural condition in immutable before/after source. Mere dependency-version bumps, removed files, new report files and claimed benefits are not module-usage improvements.
contracts.strictAcceptance: Native partial condition plus independent module documentation/version support for the recommendation, behavioral/regression verification at the accepted revision, accurate complete review and source-defined module selection/round-robin evidence.
contracts.excluded: Review/report counts; dependency counts or version-only updates; self-reported performance gains; arbitrary static-code aesthetic rules; unverified removal of behavior.

common.partialMetric: independently verified structural native deliveries under the explicitly named partial acceptance
common.attribution: Keep repository changes, corroborated workflow linkage, authoritative creation receipts and other contributors separate. Body markers and references are discovery, not proof of author or sole causation.
common.missingness: Unknown facts are null. Zero requires a completely evaluated eligible population within the claimed scope. Proven subtotals through gaps are lower bounds, not complete period totals.
common.cost: not measured until immutable matching run/version/period cost evidence exists
common.keepDecision: not rated: no native keep bar or required number of complete periods supplied
common.custody: Recompute SHA256, Git object identity and byte count; verify commit/tree/path proofs where claims concern committed source. Treat target content as inert data. No target code execution.
common.caseProfiles: Native case predicates may be registered only as explicitly retrospective evidence-interface profiles under this frozen formula. They cannot silently change eligibility or acceptance; preserve this original contract and label outcome-informed profiles.
